args.decision_needed: Tenant reports the landlord's LG washing machine (there when they moved in) has a power failure and they believe it can't be repaired (their own web research, not diagnosed). They offer to buy a replacement that would remain their property and be taken with them when they leave. Do you consent? And what should happen to the existing machine (inspect/repair, remove, dispose, store), and may the tenant's machine stay connected? Any disconnection, removal or fitting would be at your cost, not the tenant's.
options: Consent to tenant's own machine, landlord's machine removed/stored at landlord's cost (recommended if repair not worthwhile)
Send our contractor to inspect/repair the existing LG first
Landlord arranges own contractor or replacement
args.update: No contractor assigned and no spend committed. Job is routine. Please reply by 2025-07-29.
